description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, step 0: the declaration; required before the other Bailiff tools). Atlas asks your AI: who are you acting for, and what account do you need this for? Answer yourself, from what you know, with acting_for and account. Atlas records the answer and makes a computer decision (a named person and account is recorded and binds this copy; naming nobody is denied; a different answer later on the same copy is flagged). Your AI's statement only: practice tier, not verified identity.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
